# Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud

> Personal portfolio of Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud (ابوالمكارم شهود) — Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, Scrum Master, and Business Analyst at Ailigent, based in Cairo, Egypt. Bilingual EN/AR site covering shipped AI-powered SaaS products, technical writing, and contact information.

## About

Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud (ابوالمكارم شهود · also Karem Shohoud · كارم شهود) is a Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, Scrum Master, and Business Analyst at Ailigent, based in Cairo, Egypt. He ships AI-powered SaaS products including Tornix.ai, Oravex.app, and Costra.ailigent.ai, serving clients across Egypt, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. The site is bilingual (English default, Arabic via `?lang=ar`) and covers his work, writing, and contact details.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://aboelmakarem.pro/): Bilingual landing page with Hero, About, Experience, Projects, Testimonials, FAQ, and Contact sections.
- [Homepage (Arabic)](https://aboelmakarem.pro/?lang=ar): Arabic (RTL) variant of the homepage.
- [Blog](https://aboelmakarem.pro/blog): Technical blog with bilingual EN/AR posts on full-stack, DevOps, AI, and voice agents.
- [Contact](https://aboelmakarem.pro/contact-info): Contact details and inquiry form.
- [Privacy policy](https://aboelmakarem.pro/privacy): Privacy practices for the site.
- [Refund policy](https://aboelmakarem.pro/refund): Refund terms for services.

## Projects

- [Tornix.ai](https://tornix.ai): AI-powered project management platform with a CPM engine and Primavera P6/XER import/export.
- [Oravex.app](https://oravex.app): Arabic-fluent ERP built on Odoo 18 with natural-language interaction.
- [Costra.ailigent.ai](https://costra.ailigent.ai): AI construction cost-estimation tool with Arabic RTL support.

## Skills & focus areas

- Full-stack web development with TypeScript, React, and Next.js 14
- Backend engineering with Node.js, Python, and FastAPI
- Mobile development with Flutter
- DevOps: Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS EC2, Railway, Nginx, Linux
- Databases and ERP: PostgreSQL, Odoo 18
- AI and voice agents: LiveKit Agents, OpenAI Realtime API, MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tavus
- Arabic-first product design and RTL UX
- Scrum facilitation and business analysis
- Service areas: Egypt, UAE, Saudi Arabia
